documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vinsys IT Services India Limited reported strong financial performance for FY25, with consolidated revenue growing by 24% to INR 212 crores and net earnings increasing by 31% to INR 30 crores. Management highlighted robust growth in the Middle East region, driven by timely capital deployment from IPO proceeds and local office expansion. The company remains optimistic about delivering strong revenue and earnings growth in FY26, supported by Middle East expansion, software development mandate wins, and learning solutions. Additionally, management noted that cash flow from operations turned positive to INR 13 crores in FY25 compared to negative INR 11 crores in FY24. Vinsys IT Services India Limited reported a robust performance for FY25, achieving a 24% year-on-year growth in consolidated revenue to INR 212 crores and a 31% increase in consolidated PAT to INR 30 crores.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering strong revenue and earnings growth in FY26.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering strong revenue and earnings growth in FY26, as we have demonstrated historically.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the Middle East market outlook is great, with UAE ranking third globally in AI implementation and targeting number one by 2031.
demand_outlook.quote: So, outlook is great. And while the market size and the growth projections are there out in the public domain, we have got the right feet on street, specifically across GCC, where we have teams available and they have got their inroads and penetration in the B2B segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that Saudi Arabia is investing in coders and AI, creating a strong market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: And now that AI is the next focus, the focus has come back again on IT and Middle East is not investing in oil anymore, they are investing in coders.

capex_expansion.claim: Vinsys currently operates six offices in the Middle East region across UAE, Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia.
capex_expansion.quote: Vinsys currently operates six offices in the region across UAE, Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia, as regulatory tailwinds allowed us to open local offices and employ regional talent.

capex_expansion.claim: Bhopal is highlighted as one of the new additions for office expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Bhopal is one of our new additions, which will happen this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new office in Bengaluru & KSA.
The company noted Qatar office space expansion.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margins expanded as operations were streamlined while focusing on export-oriented revenue growth.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBIT margins expanded as we continue to streamline our operations while focusing on export-oriented revenue growth.

margins_costs.claim: EBIT increased by 37% year-on-year to INR 36 crores in FY25 with margins at 16.9%, up 163 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT, that is, earnings before interest and tax, increased by 37% year-on-year to INR 36 crores in FY25 with margins at 16.9%, up 163 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBIT margin was 16.9% in FY25 compared to 15.3% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBIT margin was 16.9% in FY25 vs 15.3% last year

margins_costs.claim: The company reported PAT at Rs. 10.95 crore translating into 11.9% margin with margins increased circa 20%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT at Rs. 10.95 crore translating into 11.9% margin. (margins increased circa 20%)

orders_capacity.claim: Employee headcount reached 425 as on 31st March 2025, up 23% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Employee headcount was 425 as on 31st March 2025, up 23% on year-on-year basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Total headcount increased by 23% year-on-year to 425 in FY25.
orders_capacity.quote: Total headcount increased by 23% Y-o-Y to 425 in FY25

capital_allocation.claim: IPO proceeds were earmarked for international expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: As mentioned previously, our IPO proceeds were earmarked for international expansion.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow from operations stood at INR 13 crores in FY25 versus negative INR 11 crores in FY24.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash flow from operations stood at INR 13 crores in FY25 versus negative INR 11 crores in FY24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company announced its Dividend Payout Policy of 15%.
capital_allocation.quote: The company announced its Dividend Payout Policy of 15% .

capital_allocation.claim: The company announced the ESOPs for key employees to fortify talent retention.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company announced the ESOPs for key employees to fortify talent retention.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted heightened global macroeconomic volatility, regional conflicts, and uncertain impact of trade tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Looking ahead, we continue to remain resilient despite heightened global macroeconomic volatility, regional conflicts and uncertain impact of trade tariffs.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets delivering strong revenue and earnings growth in FY26 driven by multiple expansion factors.
management_commitments.quote: We remain confident of delivering strong revenue and earnings growth in FY26, as we have demonstrated historically.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
